correctness.rationale: Generator on n and n(n-1) yields (d+r)m1=a and (2d+r)m2=2(ell+a)m1, so multiplying by v and sending v→infty at fixed ζ gives Pζ=∫2ell bζ/[(d+r)(2d+r)] d ell and Vζ=ρζ+Pζ. The self-consistency denominator stays bounded away from zero, q(1-x)=O(x^alpha) ensures bζ→1 at endpoint, and r(1-x)~Cx^nu. Singular integrand behaves like 2/[(ζ+Cx^nu)(2ζ+Cx^nu)], integrable iff 2nu<1, at nu=1/2 log coefficient 4/C², and at nu>1/2 scale x=(ζ/C)^(1/nu)y gives 2C^(-1/nu)Jnu ζ^(1/nu-2). Sympy checks moment identities, numerical quadratures Jnu at .6,.7,.8 agree within 3e-9 relative; limits are justified analytically, not by finite tests.
